authority: Fresh user answers for this personal repo. Do not inherit older salary, city or experience caps.

roles.five_year_boundary: Eligible at exactly 5 or 5+ if the technical scope fits; lower priority than the explicitly targeted 1+/2+/3+/4+. Skip a stated minimum or range maximum above 5.

compensation.unknown_salary: NEEDS_DETAIL; do not invent or reject an undisclosed salary as below the minimum.
compensation.range_crossing_minimum: NEEDS_DETAIL; a possible 15+ offer is not a confirmed eligible salary.
compensation.foreign_currency: Use only an explicitly normalized INR annual amount with a cited current conversion; no hard-coded exchange rate.

companies.matching: Match the target employer, case-insensitively; never reject a different employer just because its JD mentions responsive design or the candidate works at Responsive.

cover_letters.scope: Every job for which application materials are actually prepared, regardless of whether the portal marks the letter optional.
cover_letters.content: Evidence-backed, company/job-specific, under 300 words; no invented achievements.
cover_letters.default_source_format: Markdown/plain text; produce PDF if an attachment is needed. No DOCX requirement.

decide_later: Manual versus scheduled runs and any schedule
Artifact hosting/link strategy for tracker cells
Gmail status-check scope and follow-up policy
workflow.configuration_note: TODO means the user will choose execution behavior and limits later; it does not remove the original search, materials, status, nightly or weekly-review capabilities.

scheduling.configuration_note: Nightly search/morning reports are retained capabilities. Only activation, time, frequency and run scope remain TODO.

codex_integration.required_before_activation: Align ai-tailor, ai-apply and job-search-orchestrator with these fresh preferences; do not silently fall back to their old city, salary or experience settings.
